payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP where state j represents the number of items covered, and each item (t, c) transitions from j to min(j+t+1, n) with cost ar[j]+c to find min cost to cover all n.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a single 1D array ar of size n+1; only one index j; no 2D state is used. It is a classic 0/1 knapsack-like DP on a scalar capacity.
